spans.s: नष्ट elided or dropped a term used as a synonym of 'lupta' in some commentaries.
नष्टरूपा name given to an anustup verse which has nine, ten and eleven syllables respectively for the first, second and third feet; e.g. विपृच्छामि पाक्यान् देवान्
. The verse has got 32 syllables, but it has only three feet instead of four.
नाश elision, the word is used in grammar as a synonym of 'lopa.'

नासिकास्थान a place in the nose where a nasal letter such as ङ्, ञ्, ण्, न् or म् and anuswara get a tinge of nasalization while passing through it. The yama letters e.g the nasal क्, ख् ,ग् , घ् get nasalization in the utterance of the words पलिक्किनः, चख्ख्नतुः, अग्नि:, घ्घ्नन्ति; cf. यमेा नाम वर्णः प्रातिशाख्ये प्रसिद्धः S.K. on
. cf. also यमानुस्वारनासिक्यानां नासिके V. Pr.
नासिक्य letters or phonetic elements produced in the nose; cf. नासिकायां यमानुस्वारनासिक्या: R.
